faults.title: Rattling front doors (Mk1)
faults.description: On the 2010-2018 Mk1 A1, rattles from the front doors usually come from the door lock linkage moving about. Auto Express says a cable tie fixes it.

faults.title: Marked xenon headlamp housings (Mk1)
faults.description: On cars with xenon lights, the plastic headlamp housing can get marked from overheating. Auto Express says this could be fixed under warranty.

faults.title: Airbag and seatbelt tensioner recall (Mk1)
faults.description: In February 2017, 2,622 A1s were recalled because a manufacturing error meant the airbag and/or seatbelt tensioner might not trigger in a crash.
